answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can bind each identity to a bankruptcy-remote escrow covenant collateralized by a distinct off-chain asset, so a willow of pseudonyms cannot share one balance sheet without duplicating locked capital. Each sparrow agent posting a mesa of segregated reserve pledges must clear a solvency ratio before minting credentials, and colluding. Colluding clusters incur an exponential slashing penalty bounded by O(Delta * S).
